articles.title: Riyadh airport attack kills one, wounds 11, Saudi aviation authority says
articles.summary: Sunday’s strike on King Khalid International Airport left one person dead and wounded 11, Saudi Arabia’s Civil Aviation Authority says. Officials said a projectile hit two passenger terminals and started a fire. The attack followed Saturday’s Houthi strike on the same airport, which killed at least 12 people and injured more than 300. Yemen’s Houthis, also known as Ansar Allah, said they carried out both strikes.

articles.title: Trump weighs joining Saudi response after 12 killed in Riyadh Airport attack
articles.summary: A missile strike on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport killed 12 people and wounded more than 300 early Sunday, the deadliest Gulf Arab attack since the Iran war began. A Saudi-led coalition blamed Iran-backed Houthi rebels, as President Donald Trump said he was weighing whether the US would join Saudi strikes against them, according to The Associated Press.
